serverInfo.name: run-my-accounts-mcp
serverInfo.title: Run my Accounts MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Run my Accounts, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are overdue, and what is the total per customer?"; "Show the trial balance for the income statement from January to now."; "List all open vendor invoices and who we still need to pay.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Run my Accounts data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run runmyaccounts_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run runmyaccounts_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run runmyaccounts_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. runmyaccounts_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List all customers (debtors) with number, name, address, contact and bank data. API: GET /customers.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customer number. API: GET /customers/{customernumber}.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices. Filter by status (OPEN, PAID, OVERDUE), date range and customer number. API: GET /invoices.

status.description: Invoice status. OPEN includes due and overdue.

from.description: Invoices on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd). Default: account close date.

to.description: Invoices on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd). Default: today.

customer_number.description: Only invoices of this customer number.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_get_invoice
tools.title: Get invoice
tools.description: Get one customer invoice with its customer and line items. API: GET /invoices/{invoice_number}.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List payments of an invoice
tools.description: List the payments booked against one customer invoice. API: GET /invoices/{invoice_number}/payments.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_payments_since
tools.title: List incoming payments not processed since a time
tools.description: List incoming invoice payments that were not marked as processed after a time stamp. This tool only reads: it never marks a payment as processed. API: GET /invoices/payment_list?processed=.

annotations.title: List incoming payments not processed since a time

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_parts
tools.title: List parts
tools.description: List parts (articles) with number, description, unit, price and account numbers. API: GET /parts.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_vendors
tools.title: List vendors
tools.description: List vendors (creditors). Sort by id, name, vendornumber or score (add asc or desc) and search by name. API: GET /vendors.

query.description: Search text in the vendor name.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_vendor_invoices
tools.title: List vendor invoices
tools.description: List vendor invoices (payables) with status, amounts, paid amount and vendor. API: GET /payables.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_get_vendor_invoice
tools.title: Get vendor invoice
tools.description: Get one vendor invoice by invoice number. API: GET /payables/{invoice_number}.

invoice_number.description: Vendor invoice number, for example K-001.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_vendor_invoice_payments
tools.title: List payments of a vendor invoice
tools.description: List the payments booked against one vendor invoice. API: GET /payables/{invoice_number}/payments.

annotations.title: List payments of a vendor invoice

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_charts
tools.title: List chart of accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts. Optionally filter by account type. API: GET /charts.

tools.name: runmyaccounts_trial_balance
tools.title: Trial balance
tools.description: Get account balances (trial balance, version 2). Use x as a wildcard in accno (15xx = 1500 to 1599). Income statement accounts need from and to. API: GET /gl/v2/saldo.

accno.description: Account number filter, x is a wildcard, for example 15xx.

to.description: Include transactions until this date (default today).

project.description: Only values with this project name.

bookkeeping_main_curr.description: Show balances in the main currency (default true).

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_account_transactions
tools.title: List transactions in an account
tools.description: List ledger transactions of one account or a wildcard pattern (x matches any digit, use x for all accounts). API: GET /charts/{accno}/transactions.

accno.description: Account number or pattern, for example 1000 or 10xx.

to_date.description: Include transactions until this date (default today).

tools.name: runmyaccounts_list_departments
tools.title: List cost and profit centers
tools.description: List departments (cost and profit centers). API: GET /departments.

prompts.title: Get started with Run my Accounts
